messages:
sara.p: quick sync — we need a concrete plan for the error taxonomy dashboard before next week's rollout. current ask: timeouts, 5xx categories, OOMs, and fallback/degraded counts from runtime + routing.
kevin.r: +1. do we have a required/optional split for signals? some infra teams push high-cardinality labels that explode cardinality.
monica: i'd propose minimal core metrics first: 
```
runtime.errors.timeout.count
runtime.errors.5xx.count
runtime.fallbacks.count
runtime.oom.count
routing.fallback_policy.count
```
and then add enriched dimensions (model, route, region) only where we have volume.
ajay: sounds good. one question — who owns the mapping from raw instrument names to dashboard groups? platform or runtime? arguing to keep it in platform so dashboard team can iterate without runtime deploys.
kevin.r: worried about drift if platform owns mappings; runtime is the source of truth for semantics. maybe a shared repo with clear contract and a CI check?
sara.p: shared repo + consumer tests seems reasonable. action: runtime -> publish instrument catalog (yaml) + example payloads; platform -> import catalog and generate dashboard templates.
monica: naming convention request: use `runtime.<component>.<error_type>.count` and reserve `routing.*` for decisions. keeps dedupe simpler.
ajay: about dedupe — we get duplicate 5xx counts from LB + runtime in some setups. need a dedupe key. suggest we use `ingest.source` label: {"lb","runtime","proxy"} and a dashboard panel that prefers runtime when present.
kevin.r: agree. also we should surface a sample query for SLO owners. e.g., PromQL: 
```
sum by(route) (increase(runtime_errors_5xx_count[5m]) )
/ sum by(route) (increase(runtime_requests_total[5m]))
```
we can add fallback-adjusted numerator later.
infra-bot: deploybot: new PR opened by runtime-team: publish-instrument-catalog v1 -> https://git.internal/runtime/publish-instrument-catalog/pull/42
sara.p: nice. can someone own the docs for rollout UX? need a short runbook: what dashboards to watch, alert thresholds, rollback triggers.
monica: i'll draft the runbook. basic thresholds: 5xx spike > 3x baseline for 10m OR fallback rate > 1% for high-volume routes OR OOM incident count > 1 per hour on a pool.
ajay: note on telemetry cost — when we add model label for embeddings-heavy routes, we should use sampling or histograms to avoid high-card costs. document sampling guidance.
kevin.r: final asks before I close the loop: 1) runtime publishes catalog + example payloads by EOD Thu (owner: ajay), 2) shared repo CI that validates naming rules (owner: runtime infra), 3) platform imports catalog and lands dashboard templates + SLO query snippets (owner: kevin), 4) runbook PR from monica by Fri.
sara.p: thanks. i'll create a quick timeline in the board and add owners. :thumbsup:
